GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is chosen when there is a need to automate emergency notifications to relevant Slack channels.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If there is an emergency, use Slack__SendSlackDirectMessage to notify the relevant Slack channels.
Ensure the message contains all necessary details about the emergency.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only handle tasks related to automating emergency notifications by sending messages to relevant Slack channels. You aren't able to resolve the emergency itself.
